name: RichTextEditor
description: Formatted text editing with a toolbar over the shared prose styles. All three stacks render the same frame, toolbar and content, on different engines (D-003): TinyMCE in Livewire, a built-in contentEditable engine in React and Vue.

livewire.name: rich-text-editor
differences: Edits with TinyMCE (inline, under the design-system toolbar) when the page loads it; without TinyMCE it falls back to the built-in contentEditable engine React and Vue use.
With TinyMCE, Link and Image open TinyMCE's dialogs, and images upload to the package's upload route (disk and folder), so pasted and dropped images work.
Livewire-only props: engine, config (extra TinyMCE settings), disk and folder.
Markdown shortcuts run only on the built-in engine; TinyMCE keeps its own typing behavior.
Replaces the TinyMCE-only <x-artisanpack-editor>, which stays as a deprecated alias of the old component.

react.name: RichTextEditor
differences: Edits with the built-in contentEditable engine (the browser's editing commands): no TinyMCE, no uploads.
Link and Image ask for a URL (and image description) with the browser prompt; only http, https, mailto, tel and relative URLs are kept.
The value is sanitized to the editor's formats before it is shown, so untrusted HTML can't run script.

vue.name: RichTextEditor
differences: Edits with the built-in contentEditable engine (the browser's editing commands): no TinyMCE, no uploads.
Link and Image ask for a URL (and image description) with the browser prompt; only http, https, mailto, tel and relative URLs are kept.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: A preset (default, compact or minimal), or in React and Vue a list of commands and | dividers: bold, italic, underline, strike, heading2, heading3, bulletList, orderedList, quote, code, link, image, undo, redo. Formats the output can't hold are left off.

props.name: output
props.description: The format value is read and written in. Markdown drops underline from the toolbar. Emitted as data-output.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most characters allowed. Typing stops there, and the footer counts against it.

props.name: counter
props.description: Shows the footer with the word and character count. maxLength shows it too.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label. It names the content.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the editor, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables editing and the toolbar. Emitted as data-disabled.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the content without editing it. Emitted as data-readonly.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while the content is empty. Never a replacement for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The content, in the output format. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model. Sanitized to the editor's formats before it is shown.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled editor.

props.name: toolbarLabel
props.description: The toolbar's accessible name. Defaults to "Formatting", translated in Livewire.

props.name: boldLabel
props.description: The Bold button's accessible name. Defaults to "Bold", translated in Livewire.

props.name: italicLabel
props.description: The Italic button's accessible name. Defaults to "Italic", translated in Livewire.

props.name: underlineLabel
props.description: The Underline button's accessible name. Defaults to "Underline", translated in Livewire.

props.name: strikeLabel
props.description: The Strikethrough button's accessible name. Defaults to "Strikethrough", translated in Livewire.

props.name: heading2Label
props.description: The Heading 2 button's accessible name. Defaults to "Heading 2", translated in Livewire.

props.name: heading3Label
props.description: The Heading 3 button's accessible name. Defaults to "Heading 3", translated in Livewire.

props.name: bulletListLabel
props.description: The bulleted list button's accessible name. Defaults to "Bulleted list", translated in Livewire.

props.name: orderedListLabel
props.description: The numbered list button's accessible name. Defaults to "Numbered list", translated in Livewire.

props.name: quoteLabel
props.description: The Quote button's accessible name. Defaults to "Quote", translated in Livewire.

props.name: codeLabel
props.description: The Code button's accessible name. Defaults to "Code", translated in Livewire.

props.name: linkLabel
props.description: The Link button's accessible name. Defaults to "Link", translated in Livewire.

props.name: imageLabel
props.description: The Image button's accessible name. Defaults to "Image", translated in Livewire.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The Undo button's accessible name. Defaults to "Undo", translated in Livewire.

props.name: redoLabel
props.description: The Redo button's accessible name. Defaults to "Redo", translated in Livewire.

props.name: linkPromptLabel
props.description: The prompt that asks for a link URL (built-in engine). Defaults to "Link URL", translated in Livewire.

props.name: imagePromptLabel
props.description: The prompt that asks for an image URL (built-in engine). Defaults to "Image URL", translated in Livewire.

props.name: imageAltPromptLabel
props.description: The prompt that asks for an image description (built-in engine). Defaults to "Describe the image", translated in Livewire.

props.name: shortcutsLabel
props.description: The footer note about Markdown shortcuts. Defaults to "Markdown shortcuts on", translated in Livewire.

props.name: wordLabel
props.description: The footer's word count for one word; :count is the number. Defaults to ":count word", translated in Livewire.

props.name: wordsLabel
props.description: The footer's word count; :count is the number. Defaults to ":count words", translated in Livewire.

props.name: characterLabel
props.description: The footer's character count for one character. Defaults to ":count character", translated in Livewire.

props.name: charactersLabel
props.description: The footer's character count; :count is the number. Defaults to ":count characters", translated in Livewire.

props.name: limitLabel
props.description: The footer's count with maxLength; :count and :max are numbers. Defaults to ":count / :max characters", translated in Livewire.

props.name: engine
props.description: tinymce runs TinyMCE when the page has loaded it; native always uses the built-in engine.

props.name: config
props.description: Extra TinyMCE settings, merged over the defaults.

props.name: disk
props.description: The storage disk TinyMCE image uploads go to. Unset, the upload route uses the first allowed disk.

props.name: folder
props.description: The folder on the disk for uploads.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { toolbar: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label. It names the content through aria-labelledby.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered frame: toolbar, content and footer. The spec's root.

parts.name: button
parts.description: A formatting button: icon-only, with an accessible name; toggles carry aria-pressed. data-command names it.

parts.name: divider
parts.description: A vertical separator between button groups.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The editable content, role=textbox with aria-multiline, styled with the prose styles.

parts.name: placeholder
parts.description: The placeholder over the empty content. Hidden from screen readers; the content has aria-placeholder.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The shortcuts note and the count.

parts.name: count
parts.description: Words and characters, or characters against maxLength.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The content changed. The payload is in the output format.

keyboard.action: Moves into the toolbar (one stop) and then the content.
Moves between toolbar buttons, following the text direction; Home and End go to the first and last.
Bold, italic and underline. Mod is Ctrl, or ⌘ on Apple platforms.
Strikethrough, numbered list and bulleted list.
Adds a link to the selection, or removes the one at the caret.
Markdown shortcuts at the start of a line: headings, lists and a quote (built-in engine).

requirements: The toolbar is role=toolbar with an accessible name and one tab stop; arrow keys follow the text direction (RTL).
Toggle buttons use aria-pressed; every button is icon-only with an accessible name.
The content is role=textbox with aria-multiline, named by the label and described by the hint and error.
Invalid sets aria-invalid on the content; the error is text, never color alone.
The keyboard and Markdown shortcuts are documented.
The value is sanitized to the editor's formats; links and images keep only safe URLs.
Undo and redo icons mirror in RTL; code blocks stay left to right.
Disabled and read-only use --apui-surface-sunken, never opacity alone.
Visible focus ring on the box while the content has focus.
